pins.notes: Output frequency scaling bit 1 (S0 HIGH, S1 LOW = 20 %)

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: Square wave: its frequency follows the light level. Level = VCC: power from 3V3

pins.name: OE
pins.notes: Output enable, active LOW. Can be tied to GND

pins.notes: Use 3V3 so OUT stays at 3.3 V
